name: Foundry Import
description: Converts compendiums exported from FoundryVTT into campaign archives, folders and all, by a rules file that maps Foundry's types and fields onto your system's. Takes mana's Compendium Importer exports, or a bundle from the Export for Tavern Moot Foundry module, whose pictures and PDFs it uploads to the campaign's files (PDF pages become PDF notes).

widgets.label: Foundry import
widgets.description: Convert exported Foundry compendiums, and their pictures, into an archive, by a rules file.
